en: A color postcard view of a European city along a river, with rows of historic buildings and churches in the foreground and a bridge crossing the river. Above the city rises a steep, wooded hill topped by a large fortified complex with walls, gates and towers. On the right slope of the hill stands a prominent clock tower. Mountainous terrain fills the distant background. The printed caption at the top reads "Graz. Mur Schloßberg."
